name: The Core Gallery
reading: Blaine's town studies the crater's energy (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym7_town: core-sample racks, a field laboratory, survey tables, a fumarole vent; blackstone, basalt, tuff, copper). The Assay House above is where the town reads the vent; under it is where the town keeps what it has drilled out of it. A player leaves the assay vault by an adit cut down through the crater's rock - eleven steps south, a landing, eleven west, a flat foot - and comes into a long gallery whose walls are a drilled section of the cone in bands (deepslate, blackstone, a thin calcite ash bed, basalt flows, tuff, a second ash bed, a basalt cap), with the same bands standing in glass core tubes down both sides and the town's magma held behind glass in the walls. At the far end the assayer's stage is raised across the whole hall, and behind Blaine is the bore-hole itself: a seven-by-seven window of lava sealed in the rock behind glass, a sill of magma blocks under it, copper pylons either side.

entry.why: route_end is where Blaine stands today: one over the building's spawner (6178, 106, 5001) in the assay vault, the 'to' of data/gym_buildings/gym7.json route step 8 ('blaine'). The adit runs 11 south, a landing, 11 west and a flat foot, and lets the player out of the hall's south door onto the hall floor at (6166, 85, 5009), 28.2 from Blaine: farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1, so the player stands in the hall, with the whole gallery in view, before he can call the fight.
